This page shows how to install My project.
Replace the steps with the steps for your project.

## Install

Run the install command in a terminal.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ pip install my-project
installed my-project
```

## Check the install

Run the version command.
The output shows the version number.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ my-project --version
1.0.0
```
